item.title: github: Control where GitHub Copilot customizations come from
item.description:
Enterprise administrators can now require selected GitHub Copilot customizations to be sourced from plugins or managed settings instead of standalone user or project configuration. This works alongside marketplace restrictions for tighter governance over Copilot customization sources.

  • Source: GitHub
